Transfer Event Added Inf_Lib. Replaced TND with JMP. Initialize on First Scan. ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- The event transfer instruction is used to prefix and transfer an existing event into another event data structure that may or may not have the same data members. Using the transfer instruction provides the ablility to prefix the event message if additional context is required prior to forwarding to the target event queue. All other event data including timestamp remain unchanged.
Instruction Execution: ----- Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1010 Input message length is greater than destination message length 1011 Ref_DestinationPTR is invalid (<0 OR > (Inp_DestinationLEN-1)) 1012 Invalid Prefix Length (Inp_Prefix Length must be greater than or equal zero and less than or equal 82 characters) 1013 Inp_DestinationLEN is invalid (<2)
Revision Notes: ----- 2.0.00 - Added Inf_Lib. Replaced TND with JMP. Initialize on First Scan. 1.0.00 - Release
